name: Kosumi Tomoka
source:
A second year high school student. She is a talented person and has considerable skill. She is a member of the Naginata's club activities, and although she is usually a gentle, humble, and kind, her personality changes suddenly during practice. She was born into a family of martial artists and has a dojo at her home.

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
